description: Accept a mission by template_id (mission_id also accepted as alias). Ship must be IDLE, DOCKED or ON_MISSION. If the required goods exceed your hold, the reply says so: deliver in parts (complete_mission with mission_id); self-mined goods may be handed in before the full amount, bought ore does not count for mining missions. You can hold several missions at once -- your rank grants 3 to 10 mission slots. When the book is full, free a slot with abandon_mission. Use list_missions to see what is running.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

mission_id.description: Alias of template_id (if both are sent they must be equal).

name: accept_mission
